text:
sam: heads-up eu-west-1 warmpool join failures starting ~04:20Z. new nodes stuck at BOOTSTRAP and then drop out.
ida: I see Decrypt AccessDenied in bootstrap logs plus `caller arn` mismatches. looks like KMS policy rejecting cross-account callers.
nate: did eng-security push anything region-specific overnight?
julie: yes — role-boundary v2 rolled to eu-west-1 to enforce `kms:CallerAccount` == 9876543210 for decrypts. intended to stop lateral-use of infra keys.
sam: our bootstrap flow runs from the infra-account service role (acct 1234567890) so that explains the rejects. sample from node log: ```Apr 15 04:21:13 bootstrap error: KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied; denied: Condition kms:CallerAccount != 9876543210; caller=arn:aws:sts::1234567890:assumed-role/warmpool-bootstrap-role/xyz```
sec-bot: policy-deploy role-boundary-v2 -> eu-west-1 at 2026-04-15T03:55Z by eng-security
ida: immediate impact: warmpool can't decrypt node identity -> CI and nightly backfills are failing. if warmpool stays down we estimate fallback on-demand GPU cost +$7k/day during weekday peak.
nate: mitigation options: (A) temporary key grant for infra-account principal with strict request tag requirement, (B) quick rollback of role-boundary v2 in eu-west-1, (C) alter bootstrap to assume a principal in the target account (longer change). prefer A for speed but with narrow constraints.
julie: agree — if we do A, it must be timeboxed, require an authorize header `x-rls-temp: eu-boot-0415`, and we must add a SIEM watchlist entry. also need an auto-revoke Lambda.
sam: can we craft a grant that targets only kms:Decrypt and only for the warmpool bootstrap role ARN?
ida: yes. proposed grant snippet (will only use if sec approves):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::1234567890:role/warmpool-bootstrap-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:9876543210:key/infra-keystore",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/rls_temp": "eu-boot-0415"}}
}
```
nate: we'll set bootstrap to tag requests with `rls_temp=eu-boot-0415` during the window and schedule revert in 90 minutes. will run 4-node canary then ramp.
julie: sec approves emergency exception with those exact constraints and 90m TTL. must record the change in the security audit channel and attach the revert runbook.
sec-bot: emergency_exception granted: allow kms:Decrypt for warmpool-bootstrap-role with tag rls_temp=eu-boot-0415; TTL=90m; auditors=eng-security; audit-tag header required
ida: applying grant now. will post iam policy ARN once applied. running canary cmds: `kubectl get nodes -n ml -l pool=eu-west-warm` and `tail -n 200 /var/log/bootstrap.log`
sam: canary 1/4 -> node Ready at 7123456801. canary 2/4 succeeded. monitoring health and tokenized decrypt events.
julie: seeing decrypt entries in CloudTrail for key `infra-keystore` with requestTag=r`eu-boot-0415`. SIEM showing normal geo patterns. no suspicious volumes.
nate: risks/notes: this exception bypasses caller-account check for a single role only and requires the tag; still reduces blast radius vs full rollback. need postmortem to remove permanent cross-account dependency.
ida: follow-ups after incident: (1) implement one-shot broker in target account so bootstraps assume local principal, (2) add unit test that enforces role-boundary policies against cross-account bootstrapping flows, (3) update rollout checklist for role-boundary so infra-account owners are notified before deploys.
sam: cost follow-up: create cost ticket for fallback spend during the outage window.
ops-bot: incident INC-20260415-eu1-roleboundary created, assignees=eng-ml,eng-security, status=mitigated, followup=postmortem-20260416
ida: leaving incident open until broker PR and tests scheduled. thanks all :pray:
